question: What procedure must be initiated when the brahma-staff is absent?
premises: The brahma-staff is the principal supporting element.
An image may lack this central staff.
Absence of the staff requires corrective action.
inference: If the brahma-staff is absent, one should begin the installation of the peg.
plain_english: But if it is devoid of the brahma-staff, one should begin the installation of the peg.
